name: Brex
description: Finance and Fintech: corporate card and spend-management platform with REST APIs for transactions, expenses, cards, users, payments and webhooks.
access_notes: API access requires an approved Brex business account: an account or card admin generates a user token self-serve from the Brex dashboard (Developer > Settings) after accepting the developer API agreement. There is no sandbox — 'Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com'. Partner OAuth 2.0 credentials (authorization code, or client credentials for the onboarding API) require contacting Brex developer support, i.e. partner-gated.
mcp_notes: Composio has a BREX toolkit (84 tools, OAUTH2/API_KEY, not Composio-managed). No official Brex vendor MCP server found on developer.brex.com.
uncertainty_notes: Vendor-MCP absence based on Brex developer docs searches which surfaced only the Composio toolkit page; docs are public but token creation requires an actual Brex customer account (business underwriting), which cannot be self-served by an arbitrary developer.

evidence.note: User token generated in the Brex dashboard by an account/card admin after accepting the developer API agreement; 'Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com'.
Partner OAuth 2.0 (authorization code grant; client credentials for onboarding API) — 'This section is only for Brex developer partners'; partners obtain client ID/secret from Brex.
REST quickstart: bearer user token against https://api.brex.com/v2/users/me.
Official Webhooks API: register/list/update webhook subscriptions, HMAC-SHA256 signed events (transfers, expenses, users, referrals).
Composio Brex toolkit page: 84 tools, MCP or direct API, requires configuring your own OAuth credentials (not Composio-managed).
